purpose: Responsive behaviour of the shared component foundation at the binding viewport boundaries (UI/UX plan §13.2). UI-16 owns the release-wide audit; UI-04 proves the COMPONENT foundation.

contract.method: CSS media queries only. JavaScript device detection is forbidden (CLAUDE.md guardrail 1) and is enforced by DesignTokenSourceGuardTest.
contract.source_of_truth: resources/spa/src/design-system/tokens.json -> breakpoints; Tailwind reads the same file.

component_transformations.mobile: Labelled record cards. Every value keeps the label its column header carried; detail-priority columns move behind a per-card disclosure and are never dropped.
component_transformations.tablet_desktop: Semantic table with a caption, aria-sort on sortable headers, and tabular numerals on numeric columns.
component_transformations.shared_contract: resources/spa/src/components/ui/dataContract.ts — ONE SvColumn[] drives both, so a screen defines its data once.
component_transformations.proven_by: resources/spa/src/components/ui/SvData.spec.ts — 'renders the SAME columns the table does, from one definition'

component_transformations.method: Typed `placement` prop resolved by Tailwind md: classes. No JavaScript viewport measurement.
component_transformations.proven_by: resources/spa/src/components/ui/SvOverlays.spec.ts — 'resolves responsive placement by CSS class, never by measuring the viewport'

component_transformations.mobile: Collapsed behind a disclosure; the active-filter count stays visible on the trigger.
component_transformations.proven_by: resources/spa/src/components/ui/SvForms.spec.ts — 'shows the active count as text, so a collapsed filter is still visible'

component_transformations.mobile: Actions stack full width, so the primary action stays thumb-reachable.
The middle of a long trail is visually hidden but REMAINS in the DOM, so truncation never removes accessible information.
component_transformations.proven_by: resources/spa/src/components/ui/SvPrimitives.spec.ts — 'keeps collapsed items in the DOM so truncation is visual only'

component_transformations.mobile: Avatar only, with a complete screen-reader name.
component_transformations.proven_by: resources/spa/src/components/ui/SvShellControls.spec.ts — 'keeps a full accessible name when the text is hidden on mobile'

component_transformations.extreme_zoom: 9rem cap with internal scrolling below a 26rem viewport height, so the footer never consumes the screen (ADR-024 rule 6).
component_transformations.method: One token per band drives BOTH the footer height and the page reserve (.sv-footer-reserve). Two values that can drift apart is how obstruction defects appear.
component_transformations.proven_by: resources/spa/src/style.css; resources/spa/src/layouts/RoleLayouts.spec.ts — 'reserves the footer\'s block size so it cannot cover page content'

component_transformations.all_bands: Height-capped at 85vh with an internally scrolling body and a safe-area-aware bottom padding, so it fits at 360px and at 200% zoom without the page scrolling.
max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] — the panel can never be wider than the viewport, so it cannot push the page sideways. Collision handling is CSS, not measurement.
component_transformations.proven_by: resources/spa/src/components/ui/SvOverlays.spec.ts — 'caps its width to the viewport, so it cannot push the page sideways'

applied_to: menu items, tabs, accordion headers, pagination controls, record-card disclosures, footer links
proven_by: resources/spa/src/components/ui/SvPrimitives.spec.ts — 'keeps a 44px minimum target at every size'

not_done_here.release_wide_audit: UI-16 — every account page at every breakpoint
not_done_here.visual_regression_baselines: UI-16 (ADR-025) — the UI-04 screenshots are implementation proofs, not approved baselines
